purpose: Runs Squire's import on a memory export and a notes folder in a test world with every proxy pointed at a loopback recorder and a stand-in claude, checks the copies are kept in the owner's folder and nothing left the Mac, then reads the copies through the real safety floor and checks the job is held untrusted.
title: Memory taken in stays on the Mac and is read as untrusted

testCases.description: A memory export and a notes folder are kept in the owner's folder on the Mac, sources untouched, nothing sent off the Mac
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/memory-import.test.js::a memory export and a folder of notes are taken into the owner's folder and kept on the Mac, the sources left as they were, and nothing is sent off the Mac

testCases.description: What was taken in is read as untrusted: after the owner's profile, a send is refused as one job
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/memory-import.test.js::what was taken in is read as untrusted: a job that has read the owner's profile and then reads an imported copy is refused a send as one job

testCases.description: Files Claude Code or Squire load by name are kept by content, never under that name, a .claude folder or the handover notes
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/memory-import.test.js::files in an export that Claude Code or Squire would load by name are kept by their content, never under that name: no CLAUDE.md, CLAUDE.local.md, .mcp.json or settings.json, nothing in a .claude folder and nothing among the handover notes

testCases.description: The session's import is asked naming its sources, then holds the job untrusted; any other spelling is refused
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/memory-import.test.js::the session's import is asked first, naming every source, and once it runs the job holds untrusted input: a send after the owner's profile is read is refused as one job; spelt any other way the import is refused, yes or no
